facts.fact: The article says the New Deal Technologique was 'launched' in 2025 under the Vision Sénégal 2050 development framework; it names no adopting act or body.

On 1-2 July 2026 the digital ministry, with Smart Africa and GIZ, convened a workshop whose outcomes feed a national Blueprint for Value Creation Through Data to support implementing the New Deal Technologique.
